summary_en: ~1,973 billion yen self-tender via ToSTNeT-3 FCSR (commitment-based repurchase). Share count calculated from purchase price on trade day. Nomura Securities to borrow and sell shares; final acquisition price adjusted via VWAP averaging over two periods. Settlement July 29–August 4, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding self-share acquisition by off-exchange purchase transaction (ToSTNeT-3) – Commitment-based Share Repurchase (FCSR)
translation_en_brief:
On July 24, 2026, Shin-Etsu Chemical announced a block buyback of approximately 1,973 billion yen in common shares via off-exchange purchase (ToSTNeT-3) under a Fully Committed Share Repurchase (FCSR) framework. This represents the remaining tranche of a 250 billion yen authorization announced April 28, 2026; approximately 52.7 billion yen was already completed through a public tender offer in May–June 2026.

The transaction will execute on any trading day between July 29 and August 4, 2026. Nomura Securities will place sell orders using borrowed shares; the final share count is calculated by dividing 1,973 billion yen by the previous day's Tokyo Stock Exchange closing price on the trade date. The acquisition price will be adjusted post-execution: for two successive adjustment periods, half the acquired shares will be repriced using the arithmetic average of the VWAP (volume-weighted average price) from the day after purchase through the day before settlement, multiplied by specified adjustment ratios. As of June 30, 2026, shares outstanding excluding treasury totalled 1,859,694,761.

The company frames this as part of disciplined capital policy, balancing ROE and cost of capital while maintaining stable shareholder returns and monitoring total payout ratios.
